name: CF Delay
description: Comet Flower's DelayMobile: 2 s digital delay with 300 ms tape-style glide on Time, repeats darkened at 3.5 kHz and soft-saturated (ADAA tanh) so high Regen never runs away; stereo from a second tap 20 ms later. TEST: cost not yet measured on the pedal.

params.name: Time
params.explanation: Delay time in ms (1..2000); sweeping it glides like tape.
